item.title: Singapore: Applied AI Innovation to Empower SMEs
item.description: Nanyang Polytechnic has launched an applied AI initiative that connects students with real business challenges, helping SMEs adopt practical artificial intelligence solutions while developing future-ready digital talent.

item.title: Indonesia: Biometric SIM Registration to Boost Digital Security
item.description: Indonesia will roll out phased biometric SIM card registration in 2026, using facial recognition to improve customer data, curb digital fraud, clean inactive numbers and enhance overall security in the ecosystem.

item.title: India: AI, Geospatial Tools Boost Forest Rights Act Implementation
item.description: MoTA is actively advancing the Forest Rights Act implementation through an AI-powered FRA Atlas and WebGIS platform, validated via field engagement and student-led Smart India Hackathon initiatives.

item.title: Malaysia: Digital Platforms Accountable for Child Online Safety
item.description: Malaysia’s Online Safety Act 2025 shifts responsibility from parents to digital platforms, mandating proactive and comprehensive measures to prevent child sexual abuse material and protect children online.

item.title: Vietnam: Resolution 57 Charts Tech-Driven Growth Path
item.description: After one year, Vietnam’s Resolution 57 has accelerated digital transformation, built a nationwide innovation ecosystem and positioned science and technology as central drivers of national growth.

item.title: Malaysia: Johor Launches AI Programme to Boost Workforce Skills
item.description: Johor launches a state-backed AI training initiative to build skilled talent, accelerate digital adoption and strengthen long-term innovation-driven economic growth.

item.title: India: AI Initiatives Pave the Way for Global Leadership
item.description: India’s regional and pre-Summit AI initiatives in Rajasthan and Assam are actively driving innovation, workforce readiness, and responsible AI adoption nationwide, effectively ahead of the 2026 India AI Impact Summit.

item.title: Australia: Multi-Level Approach to AI Innovation and Deployment
item.description: Australia is steadily and proactively advancing AI through state-level applications, a comprehensive national strategy and global collaboration, ensuring innovation, ethical oversight and widespread societal benefits.

item.title: Vietnam: Digital Technology Industry Surpasses 2025 Growth Targets
item.description: Vietnam’s digital technology industry exceeded its 2025 targets with strong revenue, export and e-commerce growth, reinforcing its role as a key driver of sustained national economic expansion.

item.title: Hong Kong: Shared Supercomputing Infrastructure Boosts AI Ecosystem
item.description: Hong Kong’s AI Subsidy Scheme expands access to supercomputing, accelerating research, model development and applications while supporting efficient, scalable innovation.
